_note: Committed allowlist of legitimate OpenClaw crons (ApprovedCron, felix-truthful-reporting-01KX6MN5 data-model.md). The cron-drift detector (scripts/trust) diffs live `openclaw cron list --json` output against this baseline. Adding or removing a legitimate cron must edit this file in the same change (keeps reality == baseline). schedule_expr/tz values below were captured live via `ssh office2-claude 'openclaw cron list --json'` on 2026-07-10 and should be reconfirmed at deploy time if this baseline is not deployed same-day. Two crons (habits-morning-checkin, escalation-daily) omit `schedule.tz` in the live payload; office2's system timezone is `Etc/UTC` (confirmed via `timedatectl`), so `tz` for those two entries is recorded as `Etc/UTC` here, not America/New_York.

crons.name: habits-morning-checkin
